row.notes: vt_Sess_ControllerSystem slot 32 (+0x100). While [sys+0x364] and [sys+0x365] (sets built) are set: for each car i the active controller c = [set+0x20+(dword[set+0x10]^dword[set+0x18])*8] gives its input record through c->vtable[2] (a getter returning [c+8]) and Sess_ControllerSystem_ApplyRecord (0x14389a2b0) applies it to the car (physics record [vehicle manager+0xb0+i*8]); then the same for the spectator list. [sys+0x360] is a float countdown set to 0.1 when [[sys+0x70]+0x1ec] is 8. The controllers' own update (vtable slot 1) is not called here; the only direct caller found is the resettle step 0x1519ed8e0 (human cars).

verify.notes: V1531 vtable slot 32 (+0x100) of 0x1458824a0 confirmed by raw read. ApplyInputs calls controller slot 2 (call [rax+0x10], the [ctrl+8] getter) and never slot 1; so ApplyInputs does not run the AI update, slot 1 must run earlier in the frame or the record would be stale.
